pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Stellate or oak-leaf geometry with high-frequency crenulated edges and acute angular projections. Pixel gradients at edges are sharp, with patch centers exhibiting a uniform tan saturation.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting light-colored pathways forming a complex topological web. Junction nodes frequently exhibit three-way convergences. Corridor thickness is non-uniform, widening at the transitions between the lower neck and shoulder regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck line. Individual dark fibers form a dense, uniform fringe with consistent height and frequency against the background sky.
